The game had a sale so snatched it up. I love the DLC model for the game as well. Nothing is there that you can't get for free and all maps are free meaning the player base doesn't split up. It's really great.

Yeah, it feels like the sleeper hit in the FPS space. Not as much press or marketing as the Division had, but head and shoulders above it in terms of polish and balancing. None of the operators seem overpowered, but they're very diverse in terms of gear. And each update seems to address player feedback. Tachanka's turret is easier to place, IQ's scanner is easier to see through, Thermite lost his frags in favor of flashbangs, and Buck's shotgun is better for breaching walls.

They also replaced sledges breach charges with stun grenades which I thought was great because the breach charges were just useless. Also a few graphical tweaks that make the game look even nicer than it already does. I just love how it's taken the basic concept of counter strike and made it something so much more tactical and tense. The feeling when you're on defense waiting for the opposition and all you hear is the explosions and footsteps getting louder and closer. It's something that I personally haven't felt in a multiplayer shooter before.
